title: Generalized advantage estimation
summary: TD errors and GAE advantages with gamma, lambda, done flags and a bootstrap value, plus the critic targets.

mutants.bootstrap_through_done: Uses values[t + 1] as the next value also at a done step, so the next episode leaks into the TD error.
mutants.ignores_bootstrap_value: Uses 0 as the next value at the last step of the batch, so values[T] never enters.
mutants.no_cut_in_recursion: Does not reset the running advantage at a done step, so the advantage sum crosses episodes.
mutants.no_lambda: Drops lam from the recursion, so every call computes lam = 1.
mutants.returns_use_next_values: Adds values[t + 1] to the advantage for the return, not values[t].
mutants.td_no_done_mask: td_errors ignores the done flags and always adds gamma * values[t + 1].
